text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City finished the Satsuki Sho. Then, 
from among the spectators, she heard 
voices praising her "running" itself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If things keep going like this, people 
might finally see the "real me." Gold 
City's hopes swelled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next, conquer the "Japanese Derby" and 
claim the title of the strongest in the 
generation!
